observation.command:
cd /usr/local/bin && sed -i '/^oneshot_run() {$/,/^}$/c\
oneshot_run() {\
    # *-install-complete.service: enable daemon, remove temp units\
    local f unit instance svc\
    unit="$1"\
    instance="${unit%-install-complete.service}"\
    f="$(unit_file "$unit")"\
    svc="$(sed -n '"'"'s/.*systemctl enable --now \\([^ ]*\\).*/\\1/p'"'"' "$f")"\
    state_set "daemon-${svc%.service}" enabled\
    start_daemon "$svc" || return 1\
    state_set "path-${instance}-install-complete.path" inactive\
    rm -f "/etc/systemd/system/${instance}-install-complete.path" "/etc/systemd/system/${instance}-install-complete.service"\
    return 0\
}\
\
path_active() { [ "$(state_get "path-$1")" = "active" ]; }' systemctl
bash -n systemctl && echo SYNTAX_OK && sed -n '/^oneshot_run/,/^}/p' systemctl && grep -n "path_active\|path_deactivate" systemctl | head
